products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company (Nasdaq/TSX: TRI, CIK 0001075124) that describes itself as delivering "technology with purpose" to professionals in the legal, tax, trade, accounting, risk, fraud, and government sectors. Its stated aim is to help professionals make faster decisions, gain sharper insights, and deliver greater impact, with an emphasis on grounding AI tools in authoritative content, domain expertise, and what it calls "Fiduciary-Grade AI" principles.

The company's primary AI product is CoCounsel, a legal AI assistant integrated with Westlaw and Practical Law content and positioned for litigation support, legal research, and drafting. The site notes that a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase litigation capacity by 100%, and that global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP has deployed the next generation of CoCounsel Legal. Thomson Reuters also offers ONESOURCE+, an AI-powered platform connecting tax, trade, legal, and risk workflows, as well as an AI tool for Harmonized System (HS) code classification aimed at automating trade compliance. In August 2026, the company announced the launch of Thomson, described as its first proprietary large language model developed in-house.

The held facts confirm Thomson Reuters carries CoCounsel (originating from Casetext) as a tracked product in the Finance and Legal AI category, with noted applications in legal research, litigation support, and Westlaw integration, and a flagged consideration around attorney work product risk. No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts at this time.
